config.selection_protocol: model selection by 5-fold CV inside the training split; the test split is evaluated exactly once

results.noise_floor_derivation: y = x @ coef + eps with eps ~ N(0, sigma^2), sigma = 0.35. For the Bayes-optimal predictor f*(x) = x @ coef, E[(y - g(x))^2] = sigma^2 + E[(f*(x) - g(x))^2] >= sigma^2 for any g. Hence the irreducible floor is sigma^2 = 0.1225.
